flatten_dict: flatten a nested dictionary into a single-level dict using a delimiter to express hierarchy
sanitize_params: sanitize a params dict by converting non-primitive values to strings for safe logging
add_prefix: add a prefix to each key in a metrics dictionary separated by a delimiter
convert_params: convert an argparse Namespace or None into a plain dictionary for logging
fmt_prefix: format a string or list of strings into a single joined prefix string
